description: This file implements a discovery mechanism for Tailscale gateways on macOS, including data structures, network probing, and status parsing.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered Tailscale gateway with display name, DNS, host, and port.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Provides static methods and internal structures for discovering Tailscale gateways.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: Models the JSON structure of Tailscale status including self node and peer nodes.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers available Tailscale gateways within a specified timeout.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Collects candidate gateway nodes from Tailscale status.

methods.name: displayName
methods.description: Generates a display name for a node based on hostname or DNS name.

methods.name: normalizeDnsName
methods.description: Normalizes DNS names by trimming, removing trailing dots, and lowercasing.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to read Tailscale status JSON from common executable paths.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path of a Tailscale executable based on candidate name and environment PATH.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a process asynchronously with a timeout, capturing its output.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Runs a process synchronously, returning output or nil on failure.

methods.name: commandEnvironment
methods.description: Prepares environment variables for subprocess execution, setting TERM if missing.

methods.name: parseStatus
methods.description: Parses JSON string into TailscaleStatus object.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to probe for a gateway challenge event.

methods.name: isConnectChallenge
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket message indicates a connect challenge event.
